title: '20260515'
version: 0.51.0
date: 2026-05-15
description: Pull Codex and Claude Code local-project history into Lody, mirror new Lody conversations back to those CLIs, and stop a running CLI from the desktop.
---
### New

- Lody now syncs local-project conversation history from Codex and Claude Code. Trigger a sync or import existing history from Settings → Projects.
- New local-project conversations started in Lody are mirrored back into Claude Code and Codex, so the history stays in step in both directions.
- Added a Stop button on the desktop to terminate a running CLI.

### Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed mobile screens where parts of the UI extended beyond the viewport.
